SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.direction AS direction, c.sort_no AS sortNo, c.is_active AS isActive, COUNT(e.id) AS entryCount FROM ledger_category c LEFT JOIN team_ledger_entry e ON e.category_id = c.id AND e.team_id = c.team_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.team_id = #{teamId} AND c.is_deleted = 0
AND c.is_active = 1
AND (c.direction = #{direction} OR c.direction IS NULL)
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.direction, c.sort_no, c.is_active ORDER BY c.sort_no ASC, c.id ASC
